blocks.text: CRE:000–022 DETAILED REVIEW AND DELEGATED APPROVAL — CANONICAL

The Creation entity block was reconsidered from first principles under the standing delegated authority. The review compared five genuinely different architectures per root, scored 45 candidates across 360 criterion values, routed 125 English concepts without forced atomization, passed all 18 canonical packet checks, passed all 19 dedicated Creation entity-layer soundness checks, and passed the complete authority regression. All deterministic generated forms remained unchanged.

Approved architecture: CRE:0xx names substrate-neutral Creation entities. The inward triplet identifies one bounded form-specifying pattern maintained within one reference entity as a source for production; the outward triplet identifies one bounded product whose identity derives from productive transformation directed outward from a source; and the systemic triplet identifies one coordinated collection of generative patterns maintained across multiple participants as a shared production resource. The third trit changes only persistent, manifest, or dormant status.

CRE:000 — persistent internal generative pattern — A persistent bounded form-specifying pattern maintained within one reference entity as a source for production, independently of whether that pattern is presently expressed.
CRE:001 — manifest internal generative pattern — A bounded form-specifying pattern maintained within one reference entity that is presently expressed as a source for production.
CRE:002 — dormant internal generative pattern — A bounded form-specifying pattern maintained within one reference entity as a source for production without being presently expressed.

CRE:010 — persistent generated artifact — A persistent bounded product whose identity derives from a productive transformation directed outward from a source, independently of whether that product is presently manifest.
CRE:011 — manifest generated artifact — A bounded product of a productive transformation directed outward from a source that is presently manifest.

CRE:012 — dormant generated artifact — A bounded product whose identity derives from a productive transformation directed outward from a source and remains maintained without being presently manifest.

CRE:020 — persistent shared generative repertoire — A persistent coordinated collection of generative patterns maintained across multiple participants as one shared production resource, independently of whether that repertoire is presently expressed.

CRE:021 — manifest shared generative repertoire — A coordinated collection of generative patterns maintained across multiple participants as one shared production resource that is presently expressed.

CRE:022 — dormant shared generative repertoire — A coordinated collection of generative patterns maintained across multiple participants as one shared production resource without being presently expressed.

Design boundary: these roots do not silently encode mental inspiration, imagination, intention, represented descriptions, formal constraints, pure structural arrangement, material realization, productive activity, revision, completion, quality, aesthetic value, use, ownership, authorship, originality, provenance, scheduling, probability, or modality. A manifest pattern need not be generating anything, and a manifest artifact need not be finished, successful, valuable, or in use. Persistent identity may co-occur with manifest or dormant status; manifest and dormant are mutually exclusive for the same Creation entity at one reference time. Lexical dormancy remains distinct from runtime [2]/num uncertainty.
